CITY COUNCIL
  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA

  JULY 29, 2026 – 7:00 A.M.
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  5938 KAUFFMAN AVENUE - TEMPLE CITY

PROCEDURE TO ADDRESS CITY COUNCIL:

If you wish to address the City Council, please complete a Speaker Request Form, indicating the agenda
item number and submit it to the City Clerk. There will be a maximum 30-minute period for comments on
any subject with a 3-minute time limit on each speaker, unless waived by City Council. Written public
comments received by 5 pm the day before the meeting will be provided to the City Council and made part
of the meeting record. Please note that written public comments will not be read aloud by city staff or City
Council.

You have the opportunity to address the City Council at the following times:

  •  AGENDA ITEM: at the time the City Council considers the agenda item;

  •  NON-AGENDA ITEM: at the time for PUBLIC COMMENTS. Please note that while the City
  Council values your comments, pursuant to the Brown Act, the City Council cannot take action on
  any item not listed on the agenda; and

Speakers who wish to present documents to the City Council may hand the documents to the City Clerk at
the time the request to speak is made.

The listing of any item on the agenda includes the authority of the Council to take action on such item
and to approve, disapprove, or give direction on any item.

  1.  CALL TO ORDER – Mayor
  2.  ROLL CALL – Councilmember – Chavez, Sternquist, Yu, Chen, Man
  3.  PUBLIC COMMENT
  4.  UNFINISHED BUSINESS – None
  5.  COMMUNICATIONS

  A.  QUALITY OF LIFE

  B.  OPERATIONS

  C.  CRIME TRENDS

  D.  NOTABLE ARRESTS

  E.  CRIME STATISTICS

  F.  TRAFFIC ISSUES

6.  ADJOURNMENT

Notice: Staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business for
Council meeting agendas are available for viewing on the City’s website at
www.templecityca.gov and are on file in the Office of the City Clerk located at City Hall,
9701 Las Tunas Drive, Temple City, California, and available for review during regular
office hours. Written documentation submitted to the City Council after distribution of the
agenda packet can be obtained at the City Clerk’s Office during regular office hours.

REGULAR MEETINGS ARE LIVE STREAMED VIA THE INTERNET AT:
https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=connectwithtc

AGENDA NOTIFICATION SUBSCRIPTION:
If you wish to receive an agenda email notification, please email your request to
cityclerk@templecityca.gov or call (626) 285-2171.

ensure accessibility to this meeting.
